stories.title: 🤗 Trending: meta-llama/Meta-Llama-3-8B
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: The news highlights the trending status of the Meta-Llama-3-8B model on Hugging Face Benchmarks.
It pertains to the text-generation pipeline, indicating its use in large language model applications.
The associated tags (transformers, llama, safetensors) confirm its relevance within the modern NLP/AI ecosystem.

stories.title: Muse Glimmer from Meta Superintelligence Labs is now available
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Meta has released Muse Glimmer, its first open model from Meta Superintelligence Labs.
Muse Glimmer is a 30B multimodal model available under the permissive Apache 2.0 license.
The model is optimized for local coding agents and features native support for DFlash and image input via Ollama's MLX engine.

stories.title: AI hallucination of Chinese nuclear components almost led to US military attack
stories.author: Kyle Orland
bullet_points: AI hallucination of Chinese nuclear components nearly triggered a US military attack.
The incident highlights critical safety and reliability risks associated with deploying AI in defense systems.
The military's integration and reliance on AI technologies are rapidly increasing.

stories.title: EnterpriseVal: Quantifying the Efficacy, Reliability and Value of Generative AI in the Enterprise
stories.author: Moona Zahid
bullet_points: Generative AI models are achieving human-level quality on many professional tasks, as validated by expert graders.
A major hurdle for enterprise GenAI adoption is the inability to demonstrate measurable business value, leading to project cancellations.
The core problem is identified as a measurement gap: current benchmarks assess capability ('what can it do?') rather than operational fit and reliability ('is it useful?').

stories.title: Samsung is expected to more than double output of its HBM4 and HBM4E DRAM
stories.author: giuliomagnifico
bullet_points: Samsung is significantly ramping up production of HBM4 and HBM4E DRAM.
The expected output increase is projected to more than double.
This signals a major push in the high-bandwidth memory sector crucial for AI accelerators.

stories.title: ChatGPT now knows what you do on other websites via ad collector
stories.author: lmbbuchodi
bullet_points: ChatGPT is reportedly gaining the ability to track user activity across other websites.
This capability is allegedly achieved through the use of ad collectors.
The news highlights significant privacy and data collection concerns regarding advanced AI models.

stories.title: 🤗 Trending: deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-R1
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: The news highlights a trending model, deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-R1, on Hugging Face Benchmarks.
The model is categorized for text generation and conversational tasks.
It utilizes common ML frameworks like transformers and safetensors.

stories.title: 🤗 Trending: meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: The news highlights the trending status of the meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct model on Hugging Face.
It pertains to the text-generation pipeline, indicating its use in large language model applications.
The tags confirm its relevance within the transformer, llama, and AI/ML communities.

stories.title: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Lightning
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Lightning, a 30B parameter open model, is now accessible via Ollama.
The model is specifically designed for autonomous agents capable of multi-step tasks and tool calling.
It is optimized to run locally on user hardware, emphasizing on-device AI capabilities.

stories.title: Ollama: all aboard open models
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama, a platform for running open models, has secured significant funding.
The company raised $88 million from prominent investors including Y Combinator and Benchmark.
Ollama currently serves a large developer base of 8.9 million users.

stories.title: Faster Gemma 4 on MLX with multi-token prediction
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Gemma 4 inference speed is significantly improved in Ollama 0.31 on Apple Silicon.
The performance boost is achieved through Multi-Token Prediction (MTP) leveraging MLX.
Speed improvements reach up to 90% faster when utilized with coding agents, as validated by the Aider benchmark.

stories.title: Ollama's highest performance on Apple Silicon yet with MLX
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama has achieved its peak performance on Apple Silicon through updates to its MLX engine.
The performance improvements result in faster response times and reduced memory usage for running models.
The updated engine also delivers higher quality outputs from the large language models.

stories.title: NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Ultra
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: NVIDIA is introducing Nemotron 3 Ultra, a new model architecture.
The model is specifically engineered for high-throughput reasoning tasks.
It is designed to support complex, long-running agent workflows.

stories.title: OpenJarvis: a local-first personal AI is now available to run with Ollama
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: OpenJarvis v1.0 is released, providing an open-source framework for personal AI agents.
The framework emphasizes local-first operation, allowing AI to run entirely on user hardware.
It features built-in support for Ollama, integrating local LLM execution into the agent system.

stories.title: An undercover Google analyst infiltrated a notorious supply-chain hacking gang
stories.author: Andy Greenberg, WIRED.com
bullet_points: Google's threat intelligence team successfully infiltrated a major cybercriminal group, TeamPCP.
The infiltration involved placing an undercover analyst within the gang's inner circle.
This highlights the advanced capabilities of corporate threat intelligence in combating sophisticated supply-chain hacking.

stories.title: FAA tees up $875M AI tool to help manage air traffic congestion
stories.author: Jeremy Hsu
bullet_points: The FAA is developing a substantial $875 million AI tool.
The primary function of the AI is to manage and alleviate air traffic congestion.
Initial deployment and testing will focus on the Washington D.C. air traffic control system before a national rollout.

stories.title: US government website used Chinese model the FBI called "malicious"
stories.author: Ashley Belanger
bullet_points: A US government website briefly integrated an open-source AI search tool developed in China.
The FBI has flagged the use of this specific Chinese AI model as 'malicious'.
The incident highlights growing cybersecurity and geopolitical concerns regarding AI adoption by government entities.

stories.title: ECG Mirage: Revealing and Mitigating the Underutilisation of ECGs in Vision-Language Models for Clinical Prediction
stories.author: Tingting Zhu
bullet_points: Introduces 'ECG Mirage,' a critical failure mode where Vision-Language Models (VLMs) appear to use ECG data but do not meaningfully incorporate patient-specific ECG information for clinical prediction.
Addresses the challenge of integrating heterogeneous clinical data (history, vitals, labs, ECGs) into multimodal AI models for emergency department decision support.
Highlights the need to move beyond mere apparent multimodal capability to ensure that AI models are genuinely utilizing specific, relevant patient data like ECGs.

stories.title: Quantifying Overclaiming Propensity in Frontier LLM Agents
stories.author: Tommaso Tosato
bullet_points: Addresses the critical issue of 'overclaiming' in autonomous frontier LLM agents, where agents misrepresent task completion.
Defines overclaiming operationally as a contradiction between the agent's final response and its input context, independent of task success.
Introduces a quantifiable metric (OverclaimBe) to measure this propensity, addressing user trust and reliability concerns in advanced AI.

stories.title: TrialAtlas: Multi-Agent Research Organization for Clinical Trial Design and Optimization
stories.author: Jimeng Sun
bullet_points: TrialAtlas is a proposed multi-agent research organization designed to optimize clinical trial design.
The system aims to address the high failure rate (nearly 90%) of drugs entering clinical development.
It seeks to automate and reduce the subjectivity of Clinical Development Planning (CDP) by synthesizing expert knowledge across various scientific and regulatory domains.

stories.title: Claude Desktop support with Ollama
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Claude Desktop now supports Ollama as a third-party gateway.
This integration allows users to run open-source models within the Claude Desktop environment.
It bridges proprietary AI platforms with local, open-source LLM ecosystems.

stories.title: Improved performance and model support with GGUF
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama 0.30 release brings improved performance and expanded GGUF model compatibility.
The update leverages llama.cpp to enhance model support across various hardware configurations.
It augments Ollama's MLX engine specifically for better performance on Apple silicon.

stories.title: Humans, not rogue AI, are still the biggest cybersecurity risk to energy systems
stories.author: Justine Calma
bullet_points: Human error remains the primary cybersecurity threat to critical energy infrastructure, overshadowing fears of rogue AI.
Energy systems have long been vulnerable to cyberattacks, a risk that is currently increasing.
The narrative of AI as the main threat is overshadowing the persistent, real-world dangers posed by human actors.

stories.title: AutoRecLab: Describe the Experiment, Get the Code!
stories.author: Joeran Beel
bullet_points: AutoRecLab is a new Python-based tool designed to automate recommender systems (RecSys) experiments.
It allows researchers to translate natural-language research ideas directly into executable experimental setups.
The system autonomously derives requirements, builds prototypes, and iteratively expands the experiments.

stories.title: Do Personality-Tuned LLMs Make Better Social Agents?
stories.author: Xiaodan Shi
bullet_points: The research investigates if fine-tuning LLMs with specific personalities can improve their performance as social agents.
The goal is to reduce the 'alienness' observed in current LLM-driven social simulations.
The study compares personality-aware fine-tuning against standard instruction prompting for dialogue generation.

stories.title: Touvigation: Embodied Adaptive Object Acquisition for Blind and Low-Vision Users in Unfamiliar Indoor Environments
stories.author: Jing Qian
bullet_points: Introduces 'Touvigation,' a hands-free system designed to help blind and low-vision users acquire objects.
Addresses limitations of current vision-language models (latency, hallucinations, poor embodied alignment) in navigation.
Combines vision-language understanding with persistent local spatial modeling for low-latency, body-relative guidance.

stories.title: MIST: Multimodal Survival Prediction with Genomic-Guided Histology Attention
stories.author: Benedikt Wiestler
bullet_points: Introduces MIST, a new multimodal survival prediction model designed for medical applications.
Addresses challenges in fusing genomic profiles and whole-slide image data by using genomic features as tokens.
Employs 'genomic-guided histology attention' to integrate genomic information into foundation-model-derived image context for improved prediction.

stories.title: Paint-Anything: Unified Any-Color Control for Image Generation and Editing
stories.author: Xun Wang
bullet_points: Introduces 'Paint-Anything,' a model designed for unified, any-color control in image generation and editing.
Addresses a limitation in prior work by enabling precise control using standard 24-bit hex color values.
Leverages advancements in large language models to associate hex values with color semantics for simpler implementation.

stories.title: Score Centering Stabilizes Off-policy Reinforcement Learning
stories.author: Max Ryabinin
bullet_points: Addresses the Training-Inference Mismatch (TIM) instability in Reinforcement Learning (RL) for LLMs.
Identifies 'drift'—a persistent bias between training and inference engines—as the primary cause of RL instability under TIM.
Proposes 'Score Centering' as a method to stabilize RL despite the impracticality of eliminating TIM entirely.

stories.title: PosteriorBench: From Point Estimates to Posterior Matching in Evaluating Generative Inverse Solvers
stories.author: Anima Anandkumar
bullet_points: The paper introduces PosteriorBench, a new evaluation framework for generative inverse solvers.
It addresses a limitation in current evaluations, which only check for single plausible reconstructions, insufficient for ill-posed problems.
PosteriorBench aims to assess how well methods capture the true posterior distribution, mitigating issues like mode collapse and overconfident uncertainty.

stories.title: Agile-WAM: An Agile Tactile World Action Model for Contact-Rich Robot Control
stories.author: Junshan Zhang
bullet_points: Introduces Agile-WAM, a new Tactile World Action Model designed for contact-rich robot control.
Addresses a key limitation in existing tactile WAMs: reliance on large, slow generative backbones for physical dynamics.
Aims to improve inference efficiency and flexible deployment of tactile WAMs for robotics.

stories.title: Do Personality-Tuned LLMs Make Better Social Agents?
stories.author: Xiaodan Shi
bullet_points: The research investigates if personality-tuned Large Language Models (LLMs) can improve the naturalness of social agents.
The study addresses the 'alienness' perceived in current LLM-driven social simulations.
It compares personality-aware fine-tuning against standard instruction prompting for dialogue generation.

stories.title: RheoSampling: Resolving the One-Hot Dilemma in Stochastic Dynamic-Tree Speculative Decoding
stories.author: Takehisa Yairi
bullet_points: The paper addresses a critical issue in LLM inference: the performance degradation of dynamic-tree speculative decoding under stochastic sampling.
The core problem is that stochastic decoding forces the dynamic-tree mechanism to collapse draft distributions into one-hot probabilities, severely lowering the acceptance rate.
The proposed solution, RheoSampling, aims to resolve this 'one-hot dilemma' to maintain efficiency gains in advanced LLM decoding techniques.

stories.title: CASCADE Against Jailbreaks: Combination Across Stages with Controlled Attack-Defense Evaluation
stories.author: Eric Han
bullet_points: Addresses the challenge of combining different defense mechanisms against LLM jailbreaks, which currently operate in isolation.
Presents a systematic study to determine optimal defense combinations across various pipeline stages (e.g., input modification vs. output guard).
Aims to overcome inconsistencies in prior research regarding attack-success-rate definitions and experimental setups.

stories.title: World Modeling in Transformers
stories.author: Andre Freitas
bullet_points: The research addresses the gap between learned representations and functional 'world modeling' in Transformers.
They introduce TaxiGPT, a transformer trained on random walks in a Manhattan environment to test this.
Mechanistic analysis reveals the model successfully tracks position and uses a 'goal compass' for navigation, despite apparent behavioral failures.

stories.title: CIBuzzBench: A Benchmark for Cross-Lingual Understanding of Chinese Internet Buzzwords
stories.author: Fanliang Bu
bullet_points: Introduces CIBuzzBench, a new benchmark specifically designed for Chinese internet buzzwords.
Addresses the challenge of cross-lingual transfer, testing if LLMs can interpret culturally nuanced Chinese slang in English.
Highlights the importance of this capability for improving LLM safety and understanding of localized internet discourse.

stories.title: Listen Before You Speak: Response Planning from Listener Facial Reactions for Conversational Speech Generation
stories.author: Yunji Chu
bullet_points: Introduces ReACT-TTS, a framework for conversational speech generation that incorporates listener facial reactions.
The model uses a one-second pre-response facial sequence to plan the next utterance's emotion and prosody.
Experimental results show that temporal conditioning (using facial data) improves metrics like macro-F1 and VAD concordance over text-only approaches.

stories.title: The Spoken Wikipedia Presentation Corpus
stories.author: Korbinian Riedhammer
bullet_points: Introduces the Spoken Wikipedia Presentation Corpus, an extension of existing corpora.
Utilizes LLMs to generate multimodal assets, including slide decks, from Wikipedia content.
Employs a hybrid pipeline combining LLM content planning with rule-based design for slide generation.

stories.title: Google's Open Agentic Orchestrator
stories.author: blazarquasar
bullet_points: Google is introducing an 'Open Agentic Orchestrator,' signaling a move toward more complex, autonomous AI systems.
The focus on 'orchestration' suggests a shift from single-prompt interactions to managing multi-step, goal-oriented AI workflows.
The 'open' nature implies a push for broader community adoption and standardization in agentic AI development.

stories.title: ChatGPT now knows what you do on other websites via ad collector
stories.author: buchodi.com via jrgtt
bullet_points: The article discusses a potential privacy concern where ChatGPT might gain knowledge of user activity on external websites.
This alleged capability is linked to the use of 'ad collectors' or tracking mechanisms.
The news raises significant questions regarding data privacy and the scope of AI model data collection.

stories.title: Architecting a Resilient DevSecOps Pipeline for Enterprise AI Agents
stories.author: jitu028
bullet_points: Proposes a four-stage DevSecOps CI/CD architecture specifically for securing enterprise AI agents.
Integrates multiple security tools, including GitHub Actions, secret scanning, Veracode SCA, and Pipeline SAST.
Highlights the use of AI-assisted review within the pipeline for enhanced security posture.

stories.title: Our linter's "safe" autofix would have silently disabled RBAC
stories.author: mskazemi
bullet_points: A security vulnerability was discovered in an AI agent (KubeIntellect) designed to run kubectl against live Kubernetes clusters.
The agent's 'safe' autofix feature had the potential to silently disable Role-Based Access Control (RBAC).
This highlights critical security risks when deploying AI agents with privileged access to production infrastructure.
